title: Further Assistance To Royal Danish Consulate-General Re Jack Albeck

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
                              H.C.Siny
REPORT                        7.3.6.Special.Branch
                              Date December 2, 19 38.
Subject Further assistance to Royal Danish Consulate-General regarding
        J. Albeck.
Made by D.S. Hooking          Forwarded by Inspector ____ /

A telephone message was received by the
undersigned at 2.30 p.m. on 1-12-38 from Mr. M.I.I. Melchior,
Vice-Consul of the above Consulate, to the effect that the
Danish subject mentioned in their letter of November 28, 1938
has failed to appear in accordance with arrangements made
for his repatriation.

Mr. Melchior stated that owing to the known
habits of J. Albeck, it was possible that he had been detained
by the Police on a drunk and disorderly charge. A tele-
printer message circulated to all stations and enquiries
instituted with the French Police brought no information
regarding the man but on the morning of 2-12-38 Mr. Melchior
again telephoned stating that Mr. Albeck had put in an
appearance at the Consulate a short time before, in a drunken
condition.

Mr. Melchior is undecided at present what will
be done with Albeck and made the request that the Municipal
Police should no longer concern themselves with the man's
whereabouts, at the same time expressing gratitude for
Police assistance. He further stated that should Albeck be
detained at any time, the Danish Consulate would appreciate
being informed.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____
                              H.C.Siny
报告                          7.3.6.特别股
                              日期 1938年12月2日。
主题：关于J. Albeck一事，进一步协助丹麦皇家总领事馆。
由 D.S. Hooking 具报          经督察 ____ 转呈 /

具报人于1938年12月1日下午2时30分接到上述领事馆副领事 M.I.I. Melchior 先生的电话留言，称其1938年11月28日来信中提及的那位丹麦籍人士，未按为其安排的遣返计划露面。

Melchior 先生表示，鉴于 J. Albeck 众所周知的习性，他有可能因醉酒滋事罪被警方拘留。已向各警署分发电传讯息，并向法租界警务处进行查询，但均未获得关于此人的任何消息。然而，在12月2日上午，Melchior 先生再次致电称，Albeck 先生不久前曾出现在领事馆，当时处于醉酒状态。

Melchior 先生目前尚未决定如何处置 Albeck，并要求工部局警务处不再过问此人的下落，同时对警方的协助表示感谢。他还表示，若 Albeck 日后被拘留，丹麦领事馆希望能获知此事。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. ____ REGISTRY
7.3.6, Special Branch Stations
REPORT
Date November 30, 1938.

Subject Letter from the Royal Danish Consulate-General.

Made by D. J. Hocking Forwarded by Inspector

With reference to the attached letter from
the Royal Danish Consulate-General, requesting assistance
in locating a Danish subject named Jack Albeck, the under-
signed has been verbally informed by Consul-General Poul
Scheel that the man in question has been contacted by the
Consulate-General since their communicating with the
Shanghai Municipal Police. He states that arrangements
have been made whereby Mr. Albeck will be repatriated to
his home country, sailing from Shanghai on December 1, and
an official letter to that effect will be forwarded to the
Commissioner of Police after that date.

D. J. (Special Branch).

D. S.
（批：P.A. to Commissioner
Information. No
further action called for
J. Rob. Richardson
Dec (-)）

档案号 ____ 登记室
7.3.6, 特别股 各警署
报告
日期 1938年11月30日。

主题：丹麦皇家总领事馆来函。

由 D. J. Hocking 具报 经督察转呈

就附上的丹麦皇家总领事馆来函而言，该函请求协助寻找一名名为 Jack Albeck 的丹麦籍人士，具报人已口头获悉总领事 Poul Scheel 告知，自该馆与上海公共租界工部局警务处联系以来，领事馆已与当事人取得联系。他表示，已作出安排，Albeck 先生将被遣返回国，于12月1日从上海启航，此后将就此事宜向警务处处长致送正式公函。

D. J. (特别股)。

D. S.
（批：呈警务处处长阅知。
无需采取进一步行动
J. Rob. Richardson
12月(-)）

November 28, 38.

The Consul General,
Royal Danish Consulate-General,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No. J. No. 61 K. 359 dated November 28, 1938,
and in reply have to inform you that the matter is
receiving attention the results of which will be com-
municated to you in due course.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne,
Commissioner of Police.
